segments.ja443:1.1: Yo te imaṃ visālakkhiṃ, piyaṃ samhitabhāsiniṃ [sammillabhāsiniṃ (sī. pī.), sammillahāsiniṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja443:1.3: Ādāya balā gaccheyya, kiṃ nu kayirāsi brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja443:2.1: Uppajje [uppajja (sī. pī.)] me na mucceyya, na me mucceyya jīvato;
segments.ja443:3.1: Yaṃ nu pubbe vikatthittho [vikatthito (ka. sī. syā. ka.)], balamhiva apassito;
segments.ja443:3.3: Svajja tuṇhikato [tuṇhikato (sī.), tuṇhikkhako (pī.)] dāni, saṅghāṭiṃ sibbamacchasi.
segments.ja443:4.1: Uppajji me na muccittha, na me muccittha jīvato;
segments.ja443:5.1: Kiṃ te uppajji no mucci, kiṃ te na mucci jīvato;
segments.ja443:5.3: Rajaṃva vipulā vuṭṭhi, katamaṃ tvaṃ nivārayi.
segments.ja443:6.1: Yamhi jāte na passati, ajāte sādhu passati;
segments.ja443:6.3: So me uppajji no mucci, kodho dummedhagocaro.
segments.ja443:7.3: So me uppajji no mucci, kodho dummedhagocaro.
segments.ja443:8.3: So me uppajji no mucci, kodho dummedhagocaro.
segments.ja443:9.1: Yenābhibhūto kusalaṃ jahāti, parakkare vipulañcāpi atthaṃ;
segments.ja443:9.3: Sa bhīmaseno balavā pamaddī, kodho mahārāja na me amuccatha.
segments.ja443:10.1: Kaṭṭhasmiṃ matthamānasmiṃ [manthamānasmiṃ (pī.), maddamānasmiṃ (ka.)], pāvako nāma jāyati;
segments.ja443:10.3: Tameva kaṭṭhaṃ ḍahati, yasmā so jāyate gini.
segments.ja443:11.3: Sārambhā [sārabbhā (ka.)] jāyate kodho, sopi teneva ḍayhati.
segments.ja443:13.1: Anedho [anindho (sī. ka.), anindo (syā.)] dhūmaketūva, kodho yassūpasammati;
